summary: Master the art of sales and marketing with our comprehensive training course. Equip yourself with essential tools to excel in today's competitive market.
lede: Sales and marketing management connects customer and market analysis, campaign planning, and pipeline oversight within a shared commercial plan. It is designed for sales and marketing managers, business development and account leaders, and commercial teams coordinating growth. Learners practice setting sales and territory plans, designing customer-journey campaigns, aligning lead qualification, and using CRM data and dashboards to assess pipeline performance and forecast revenue.
audienceIntro: This training is perfect for: Sales Managers responsible for hitting revenue targets and managing pipelines. Marketing Managers overseeing campaigns that must deliver qualified leads. Head of Sales and Marketing integrating strategy across commercial teams. Business Development Managers driving new client acquisition and growth. Key Account Managers aligning account plans with marketing support. Commercial Directors coordinating sales, marketing, and channel strategies. Product Marketing Managers connecting positioning with sales enablement. Regional Sales Managers leading field teams and local demand generation. CRM Manager ssupporting sales and marketing data quality and reporting. Revenue Operations Leads optimizing processes between sales and marketing.
